description: This file contains shell functions for managing UBI volumes and environment configurations specific to the BCM4908 platform, including reading metadata, setting environment configs, verifying and mounting UBI volumes, and handling firmware state.

methods.name: get_hex_u32_le
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte little-endian unsigned integer from a file at a specified offset.

methods.name: bcm4908_pkgtb_setup_env_config
methods.description: Sets up the environment configuration for UBI volume access by reading size information from a UBI partition and writing it to a config file.

methods.name: bcm4908_committed_image_seq
methods.description: Reads the committed image sequence number from environment variables stored in a temporary config.

methods.name: bcm4908_verify_rootfs_data
methods.description: Verifies the 'rootfs_data' UBI volume against the current firmware image and updates the volume if necessary.
